name: 03070 · New Boston, NH
findings: ZIP 03070 (New Boston) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03070 (New Boston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03070 (New Boston) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
